It was played from 20 August 2021 to 30 May 2022. [[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.|Mamelodi Sundowns]] won the title for the fifth consecutive year, qualifying for the [[2022–23 CAF Champions League]] along with [[Cape Town City F.C. (2016)|Cape Town City]]. [[Royal AM F.C.|Royal AM]] and [[2021–22 Nedbank Cup|Nedbank Cup]] runners-up [[Marumo Gallants F.C.|Marumo Gallants]] qualified for the [[2022–23 CAF Confederation Cup]]. ==Team changes== The following teams changed division since the 2020–21 season. ===To National First Division=== '''Relegated from [[2020–21 South African Premier Division]]''' * [[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]] ===From National First Division=== '''Promoted to 2021–22 South African Premiership''' * [[Sekhukhune United F.C.|Sekhukhune United]] (promoted as champions){{Cite web |date=2021-06-12 |title=Official: Sekhukhune United promoted to DStv Premiership |url=https://www.kickoff.com/news/articles/south-africa-news/categories/news/premiership/official-sekhukhune-united-promoted-to-dstv-premiership/700681 |access-date=2021-08-27 |website=Kick Off}} ===Purchased statuses=== * [[Marumo Gallants F.C.|Marumo Gallants]] purchased their status from [[Tshakhuma Tsha Madzivhandila F.C.|Tshakhuma Tsha Madzivhandila]]{{Cite web |date=2021-08-17 |title=New name, new owners but same old problems!
